title: skills: teach rollupSourceUnreadableReason beside security-rollup-source-unreadable (follow-up of #34664)
body:
repo:objectstack#2 · os-steve · session_01ADHkmQ2SN4K183oqAvUajA

Filing gate ②: the `Skills-docs: follow-up` owed by #34664's PR (new authorable key `rollupSourceUnreadableReason` on a permission set's field entry, named by this seat on 2026-11-17 at 09:22Z). Dedupe: `rollupSourceUnreadableReason skill`; no open card.

Suggested-grade: p2 · domain:skills · Blocked-by #34664

## 维护者速读

- 现象：#34664 落地后，作者可以在权限集字段条目上用 `rollupSourceUnreadableReason` 声明「这个集可以看汇总、不看明细」,lint 把那条提示降为注释。技能还只教两条出路(给子对象读权限，或遮掉汇总列)。
- 为什么要修：不教，AI 写 hotcrm 这类应用时仍会用无效的读授权去压警告。
- 需要你做的：无(分诊定级)。

## Change

1. `skills/objectstack-data/rules/relationships.md` (the paragraph "Never finish with security-rollup-source-unreadable standing", ~L228): add the third way, proposed text: "If the request says this set should see the total but not the children, keep the column readable and acknowledge it on the set's entry with the reason: `fields: { 'project.task_count': { readable: true, rollupSourceUnreadableReason: 'Clients see progress counts, not tasks' } }` — the warning becomes a note quoting it. Never add the reason to silence a total the request withholds; mask it instead."
2. `skills/objectstack-data/evals/hooks-security-seeds-datasources.json`: keep the case at ~L197 (request forbids the total → mask); add one where the request says the set sees the total but not the rows → acknowledge with a reason.

## Done when

Both land after #34664's key ships in a release the skills target.
